about: Every place the estate decided what words MEAN by matching them, from the word-matching audit of 23 Sep 2026 (class i: a decision about meaning that must become reasoning). founder_instruction 886-903: 'NO word matching anywhere'. 'migrated' = the meaning now comes from _shared/think.ts and its 'proof' is enforced by scripts/checks/decision_points_are_reasoned.test.mjs. 'pending' = still word-decided, in the order they will be migrated (customer-facing and money first). A regex that guards OUR outgoing text, or parses a format, is not listed: the ruling permits it.

points.decides: classify: the RULES regex lists (sensitive_legal, complaint, supplier_enquiry, sales_lead, question, praise) and ABUSE/ASKS decide what a public comment is, whether it is hidden, answered or handed off (#866)
isFiguresCommand: a word list decides a WhatsApp message asks for the company figures (and so what a non-founder is answered) — found by batch B2
menuChoice: a typed menu TITLE matched as words picks the menu branch (exact menu ids / digits stay as format parsing; free text is reasoned) — found by B2
founderCommand: a command grammar read from the founder's free text; stays only if it is exact-token structured commands, otherwise reasoned — found by B2
fn_kb_route_decide: alias substring matching routes an intake to a catalogue category — found by B2
quoteAnswer: FIELD_RE / QUOTE_RE and a shared-word score decide which quote field a question asks about — found by B1
onTopic passage filter (~line 377): a shared word decides a knowledge passage answers the question — found by B1
the top-passage shared-word check and tok() FAQ scoring decide which answer the widget gives — found by B1
section regex list and service-alias matching label BOQ lines in Arabic documents — found by B7
points.held: Under the hold an unread BOQ heading is filed once per heading text (boq_section:<key>) and shows in its original words; the replay writes the reasoned heading to boq_section_reading (fn_reason_apply_documents__boq_arabic). Line descriptions are never labelled: the supplier prices the original.

points.decides: installation status read off text beginning "Included" — found by B7
points.held: No reasoning is involved and nothing is held: installation arrives as the structured fields standardise() writes (installation_included / installation_detail) from the supplier's own yes/no choice, never read back off our sentence.

points.decides: arDuration / EMIRATES: duration and emirate read from free text (format parsing if the text is a structured value; meaning if free text) — found by B7

readConfirmAnswer: YES / NOT_SURE regexes and a 5-letter shared-word match decide whether the customer confirmed the drawing quantities, is unsure, or changed a number, and which BOQ line the number belongs to (settleLines, inquiry_intake) — found by B9 sweep

isUnsubscribeRequest: the PHRASE regex (unsubscribe|stop|remove me|opt out|Arabic) on subject/first line decides an inbound email asks to stop mail; resend_inbound suppresses the sender — found by B9 sweep
replyIntent: EN/AR approve regexes decide a reply approves the month of public posts (fn_marketing_calendar_reply) — found by B9 sweep
SUPPLY_RE / INSTALL_RE word lists decide a supplier is supply-only and whether a catalogue line speaks of installation work (supplier_services, service_meaning) — found by B9 sweep
PERSON / CONTACT / ADDRESS regexes decide whether a catalogue line is a statement, a heading or contact details — found by B9 sweep
meaningCandidates / proposeByMeaning: shared head words and alias patterns decide which catalogue lines are read and whether an embedding proposal is "worded" — found by B9 sweep
rewriteServices / servicesFromText / tradesFromText: exact-alias termPattern matching decides which services and trades a supplier's words name (beyond isInstallWork) — found by B9 sweep
tradesFromText: alias substring hits decide the trades a supplier's documents name (supplier_doc_trades) — found by B9 sweep

crossCheckServices: svcTerms token overlap (>=60% agree, any partial, none conflict) decides whether typed services agree with the documents; a conflict writes a needs_review action — found by B9 sweep
detectEmirate (a copy of classify.ts): a regex table of the seven emirates decides the emirate of a visitor's free text — found by B9 sweep
normEmirate: .includes on emirate names and /rak|uaq|auh/ decide a licence's emirate from the model's free-text field — found by B9 sweep
notes(): /fp 200|isol|glass|cable/ picks note lines and glass|call point + sounder + loop + have|fitted decides loop isolators are fitted (BOQ lines) — found by B9 sweep
sheet reading: /PLAN|SCHEDULE|DETAIL/ title pick then /DEMO/ /SCHEDULE/ /PLAN/ decide a sheet's kind, and /^(DEMO|REMOVE)/ marks a scope note demolition — found by B9 sweep
roleOf / layoutOf SIGNS / TOTAL / HEADING: header and row words decide a column's role, the BOQ convention, and whether a row is a total or heading (borderline: label reading) — found by B9 sweep
expiryFromText: EN/AR expiry keywords decide which date in a licence is its expiry — found by B9 sweep
~line 670: .includes("turnkey") and /supply|material|product/ on scope_type / role_needed decide whole_scope / supplies / executes (meaning only if role_needed holds free text) — found by B9 sweep

fn_faq_answer: greeting/thanks regexes, a "supplier question" regex and a full-text @@ rank fallback decide intent, which FAQ answers, and whether supplier FAQs apply (wa_inbound, site_assistant, sales_engineer, ai_gateway) — found by B9 sweep
fn_spec_offer_whatsapp_reply: ^(no|decline|لا)$ / ^(yes|ok|نعم)$ / ^(option )?[0-9]$ regexes decide the customer accepted, declined or picked an alternative — found by B9 sweep

fn_document_classify (and fn_wa_attach_document in the_agent_remembers_and_it_can_take_your_trade_licence.sql): v_cap ~ (trade|licence|رخصة) / profile|brochure / terms|agreement on the free-text caption decides the document class — found by B9 sweep
fn_support_corpus_search: lexeme OR to_tsvector @@ decides which passage answers a public question (marketing_social, site_assistant) — found by B9 sweep

fn_sales_assist, fn_accountant_assist, fn_it_engineer_assist, fn_marketing_assist, fn_ceo_knowledge_search, fn_support_knowledge_search: lexeme = any() hit counts and @@ tsquery decide which knowledge applies to a question — found by B9 sweep
fn_org_task_consume_tick: shared-lexeme coverage between a queued question and an FAQ question decides it is already answered and closes the task — found by B9 sweep
fn_supplier_portfolio_gaps: taxonomy_trade_service.aliases regex-prefix matched on the supplier's words decides which services the portfolio covers — found by B9 sweep
fn_accountant_bank_reconcile: bl.description ilike '%stripe%' decides a bank line is Stripe money (payout matching, unexplained-credit findings) — found by B9 sweep
fn_challenge: p_proposal ~* (fee|price|commission|campaign|customer|demand) decides a proposal is a pricing/demand change and adds challenge weight — found by B9 sweep
fn_kpi_review / fn_org_task_fill_ownership: task title/detail ~ \y goal_key \y decides which goal a free-text task serves — found by B9 sweep
a00_agent_knowledge_metadata trigger: title ~* regulat|licen[cs]|complian|tax|vat|law|decree decides an entry is regulatory (180-day review) — found by B9 sweep
trg_emit_competitor_pricing_changed: ~* (price|pricing|fee|commission|subscription|free) on competitor text decides a change is a pricing change — found by B9 sweep
fn_price_guidance: the question regex (cost|price|how much|سعر|بكم) decides whether a question is about price at all (the price-book like is a separate registered point) — found by B9 sweep
